_about: Crash-log rules. Each rule's 'match' is a list of conditions that must ALL hold. See src/core/crashlog/match.ts for the condition language. Numbers may be written as hex strings ("0x4c58"). Every rule must be backed by a real log in fixtures/crash_logs/ or a documented source.

rules.title: This file isn't a crash report
rules.summary: This looks like {kind}, not an Atmosphère crash report, so there's nothing to diagnose here. Crash reports start with the line "Atmosphère Crash Report".
fix: Look for files named like 01793920898_01006a800016e000.log in atmosphere/crash_reports/ instead.

rules.title: Not Smash: a homebrew app crashed
rules.summary: This crash came from the homebrew menu (hbloader), not from Smash Ultimate. The app that crashed was "{app}". {appAdvice}
fix: {appFix}
This crash has nothing to do with your Smash mods, so you can ignore it when debugging Smash.

rules.title: Skyline's page-boundary bug
rules.summary: Skyline (the code-injection framework every Smash plugin relies on) crashed on purpose while checking a patch. It checks a 4-byte patch by reading 8 bytes; on game 13.0.5 one patch sits at the very end of a memory page, so the extra 4 bytes come from the next page, the check fails, and Skyline aborts. In practice it shows up when Smashline is installed. Your mods themselves are not the problem.
fix: Replace atmosphere/contents/01006A800016E000/exefs/subsdk9 with a Skyline build whose patch check reads 4 bytes (the patched subsdk9). Keep main.npdm.
Run the SD Card Scanner: it identifies which subsdk9 you have by its hash.
Until then, removing Smashline (romfs/skyline/plugins/libsmashline_plugin.nro) avoids the crash, but movesets won't work.
evidence: PC = {pc} (the deliberate abort in Skyline's patch check)

rules.title: A moveset built for an older Smashline is running on Smashline 2.0
rules._builds: LR offset 0x340 and PC 0x55d8 are from the official Smashline 2.0.0 build. Add new offsets here when a new build ships.
rules.summary: Smashline 2.0.0 changed how movesets ask it to copy a weapon (clone_weapon). A moveset built for Smashline 1.6.8 or older passed a number where 2.0 expects text, and Smashline crashed reading address {address}. One of your movesets is too old for Smashline 2.0.
fix: Find the moveset: run the SD Card Scanner. It lists movesets that use clone_weapon and were built for the old Smashline.
Either update that moveset to a Smashline 2.0 version, or move it out of ultimate/mods/.
Or go back to Smashline 1.6.8 (libsmashline_plugin.nro), which runs old movesets but not 2.0-only ones.
evidence: Fault address = {address} (a small number used as a pointer)

rules.title: A moveset built for Smashline 2.0 is running on Smashline 1.6.8
rules._builds: LR offset 0xa0 and PC 0x540c are from the official Smashline 1.6.8 build.
rules.summary: The reverse mismatch: a moveset built for Smashline 2.0 is running on Smashline 1.6.8. It used 2.0's new clone_weapon layout, so 1.6.8 treated the length of a name ({address}) as a memory address and crashed.
fix: Install Smashline 2.0.0 (libsmashline_plugin.nro) for that moveset.
If you need 1.6.8 for other movesets, keep the new moveset out of ultimate/mods/ for now.
The SD Card Scanner flags movesets that were updated after Smashline 2.0 came out (28 Oct 2026).
evidence: Fault address = {address} (a string length used as a pointer)

rules.title: Param Config couldn't open a mod file
rules.summary: The Param Config plugin tried to open a file in your mods folder, the file system said the data was broken or missing (result {result}), and the game aborted. In real cases this was caused by disabled mods (folders starting with a dot) left inside ultimate/mods/, and by broken entries in that folder.
fix: Move disabled mods (folders whose name starts with '.') out of ultimate/mods/ into a separate folder such as ultimate/mods_all/.
Delete or repair broken entries in ultimate/mods/ (for example a mod that shows up as a single file instead of a folder).
Run the SD Card Scanner to find these automatically.

rules.title: ARCropolis couldn't open a mod file
rules.summary: ARCropolis (the plugin that loads your mod files) tried to open a file inside a mod and the file system refused (result {result}). In a real case this was The CSK Collection's optional config folders being active without the CSK plugin installed, plus disabled mods still inside ultimate/mods/.
fix: If you use The CSK Collection's extra folders (e.g. 'Unlock All Characters'), make sure libthe_csk_collection.nro is in romfs/skyline/plugins/. Otherwise move those folders out of ultimate/mods/.
Move disabled (dot-prefixed) mods out of ultimate/mods/.
Run the SD Card Scanner.

rules.title: A mod folder is malformed
rules.summary: ARCropolis crashed while copying mod file data into the game. In the real case behind this rule, one mod folder ('ultron') contained a second mod nested inside it and was missing its own plugin.nro. Something in your mods folder has the wrong layout.
fix: Run the SD Card Scanner: it looks for mods nested inside other mods, missing plugin.nro files and the same plugin copied into two mods.
To confirm by hand: move half of your mods out of ultimate/mods/, launch once, and repeat with the half that crashes.

rules.title: A moveset's own code crashed
rules.summary: The crash happened inside the code of a moveset, in the module "{module}". That's the moveset's own code, not Smashline or ARCropolis, so that moveset is broken on your game or plugin versions.
fix: Find the mod that contains {module} (usually its name gives it away) and move it out of ultimate/mods/.
Check its GameBanana page for an update for game 13.0.5 / your Smashline version.

rules.title: A normal fighter crashed while Smashline was running its scripts
rules.summary: The game crashed mid-match while running {fighterName}'s normal (unmodded) scripts through Smashline's script interpreter. No moveset's code is involved, so this is most likely a Smashline issue with that fighter.
fix: Report it to Smashline's GitHub issues and attach this log.
Workaround: avoid {fighterName} until Smashline is updated, or try the other Smashline version.
